author: Chuy García <chuy@dappnode.io> (https://github.com/dappnode)
description:
Nextcloud gives you access to all your files wherever you are. Run your own cloud storage, calendar, contacts, and office suite on your DAppNode — fully self-hosted and private.

This package includes Nextcloud with MariaDB and Redis for optimal performance.

**Features:**
- File sync and sharing across all your devices
- Calendar, contacts, and task management
- Collaborative document editing
- Photo and media management
- MariaDB database for reliability
- Redis caching for fast performance

**First run:** Visit the Nextcloud UI link below to complete the setup wizard and create your admin account.

Access Nextcloud at http://nextcloud.dappnode:8034
name: nextcloud.public.dappnode.eth
shortDescription: Self-hosted cloud storage and collaboration platform
